description: FNPF 2D regular waves of fnpf_2d_regular (relaxation generation and beach) with the theta-Robin time integration (A 310 5, REEFMG A 306 1, A 302 4, A 304 1e-3, A 307 1e-2) at twice the RK3 step of N 47 0.75 (N 51 2, N 47 1.5): relaxation zones in the Robin rows per time as an RK3 run with 200 steps per wave period (A 303, default -200 since fnpf_theta_robin/0032; -0.1 before).
covers: fnpf_theta with relaxation zones and REEFMG
